Soft Skills Club — первое и крупнейшее в России студенческое сообщество по развитию мягких (гибких) компетенций, созданное в 2019 году в Финансовом университете при Правительстве РФ. За время работы клуба его резидентами, выпускниками и слушателями стали более 2000 студентов.

Клуб создаёт среду для внутреннего обучения (Learning‑by‑doing), формирует уникальные закрытые и открытые проекты и курсы. Мы ходим в гости в топ‑компании, приглашаем известных коучей, бизнес‑тренеров, управленцев, предпринимателей и экспертов, которые бесплатно проводят мастер‑классы, воркшопы, тренинги и курсы. Но самое главное — в SSC можно не только посещать мероприятия, но и самим создавать их, воплощая свои идеи и проекты.

В клубе действует 8 департаментов, в каждом из которых развивают самые актуальные навыки будущего:

1. Дизайн — работа с линиями, цветом, формой, типографикой, реализация творческих идей.
2. Медиа и PR — искусство фотографии, копирайтинг, монтаж видеороликов, ведение социальных сетей, связи с общественностью и продвижение.
3. Психология — умение слышать себя, понимать и принимать свои эмоции, эффективно взаимодействовать с другими.
4. Тимбилдинг — создание уютной атмосферы в компании, умение находить общий язык с разными людьми и формировать команды.
5. Лидерство и карьера — развитие управленческих качеств и построение карьерной траектории.
6. Цифровые навыки — адаптация и вдохновение в мире быстро меняющихся технологий, использование мягких навыков в условиях цифровизации.
7. Коммуникации — развитие навыков общения с другими людьми, а также навыков, которые помогают успешно выступать на публике, убеждать и влиять на других.
8. Мышление и обучение — развитие критического мышления и навыков самообучения.

Помимо этого, в клубе есть ряд спецпроектов:

· «Книжный психолог» — анализ книг через призму психологии.
· «Ледокол» — душевные и атмосферные мероприятия для весёлого времяпрепровождения и поиска новых друзей.
· «Цифровой компас» — использование современных инструментов для повышения цифровой грамотности.
· Школа «Сорока» — совместный проект департаментов «Медиа и PR» и «Дизайн»: освоение важнейших навыков в сферах медиа и дизайна с помощью топ‑спикеров.
· «БЕЗВОДЫ» — топ‑работодатели и спикеры делятся ценными советами и инсайтами для построения карьеры.

text: Военный учебный центр при Финансовом университете — структурное подразделение, где студенты очной формы обучения могут пройти военную подготовку параллельно с гражданским образованием.
Обучение добровольное, на основании договора с Министерством обороны РФ.
Программы подготовки:
офицеры запаса — 2,5 года (3–7 семестры);
сержанты запаса — 2 года (3–6 семестры).
Военно-учётные специальности:
офицеры — ВУС 030400, 030405, 030406, 097000 (ракетные войска и артиллерия), 310101, 310201 (финансовые службы ВС РФ);
сержанты — ВУС 140 (реактивная артиллерия), 143 (миномёты).

К отбору допускаются студенты 1 курса бакалавриата и 2 курса специалитета очной формы обучения. 
Отбор проводится в марте–июле и включает: подачу заявления на имя ректора, медосвидетельствование, профотбор и сдачу физнормативов. 
Студенты с 4 категорией профпригодности не допускаются, со 2 и 3 — проходят две волны отбора.

Занятия проходят один день в неделю (9 академических часов: 6 — с преподавателем, 3 — самостоятельная работа). После теоретического курса — 30-дневные сборы в июле (для офицеров — на 4 курсе, для сержантов — на 3 курсе).
присваивается звание «лейтенант» или «сержант» с зачислением в запас.

Для московских студентов — 
в установленные сроки необходимо прийти в ВУС с паспортом, приписным удостоверением и СНИЛС, дальше вся информация электронно поступит в военкомат.

Для иногородних студентов — нужно встать на учёт в московский военкомат для получения отсрочки, а в дальнейшем для поступления в ВУЦ. 
Необходимо предоставить в районный военкомат паспорт и приписное удостоверение/военный билет. После постановки на учет можно идти в ВУС и получать отсрочку от срочной службы на период обучения.

Адрес: Москва, ул. Касаткина, д. 15. 
Телефон: +7 (499) 270-22-62.

text: To conscientiously perform labour duties, observe labour discipline and occupational safety requirements, and immediately report situations that threaten the life and health of people or the safety of property.

text.text: Rules for students under the Code

text: To strive to become a worthy specialist and professional in the chosen field.
To show respect, politeness, and tolerance towards teachers, staff, and other students.
To make decisions consciously and bear personal responsibility for one's actions.
To demonstrate conscientiousness and activity in studies, to develop a creative approach and professional competencies.
Not to allow dishonesty, deception, or fraud in the educational process.
To exclude rudeness, humiliation of dignity, and profanity, and not to use the internet for familiarity.
To respect others' intellectual property and to cite sources.
Not to present others' work as one's own.
Not to use personal connections or offer rewards to obtain a higher grade.
To participate in student self-government and extracurricular activities.
To show care for first-year students, to help international students and persons with disabilities adapt.
To refrain from actions that detract from the honour and dignity of other students.
To take care of the university's infrastructure.
Not to participate in the organisation of unauthorised events on or off the university premises.
To have an appearance that corresponds to the business dress code adopted at the university.
The university has adopted a business dress code characterised by restraint, strictness, elegance, and neatness.
It is forbidden to wear tracksuits, jeans with tears and rips, shorts, and miniskirts.
It is forbidden to wear transparent and overly tight clothing, vests and tops with bare shoulders and deep necklines.
Sloppy and untidy appearance is forbidden.
Flashy and extravagant hairstyles with bright colouring are forbidden.
Flashy accessories and cosmetics are forbidden.
Sharp and overly strong perfume scents are forbidden; preference is given to light and unobtrusive fragrances.

Soft Skills Club is the first and largest student community in Russia focused on developing soft (interpersonal) competencies. It was founded in 2019 at the Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation. Over the years, more than 2,000 students have been involved as residents, alumni, or participants in our educational and project activities.

The club fosters a learning‑by‑doing environment and runs a variety of exclusive closed and open projects and courses. We visit top companies and invite renowned coaches, business trainers, executives, entrepreneurs, and experts who deliver free masterclasses, workshops, training sessions, and courses. Most importantly, at SSC you are not just an attendee – you can also create your own events, bringing your ideas and projects to life.

The club is structured into 8 departments, each dedicated to a specific set of future‑ready skills:

1. Design – working with lines, colours, shapes, typography, and turning creative ideas into reality.
2. Media & PR – photography, copywriting, video editing, social media management, public relations, and promotion.
3. Psychology – learning to listen to yourself, understand and accept your emotions, and interact effectively with others.
4. Team Building – creating a warm and supportive atmosphere, finding common ground with diverse people, and building strong teams.
5. Leadership & Career – developing managerial qualities and mapping out your career trajectory.
6. Digital Skills – adapting and staying inspired in the fast‑paced world of technology, and applying soft skills in a digital environment.
7. Communications – honing interpersonal skills, public speaking, persuasion, and influencing others.
8. Thinking & Learning – cultivating critical thinking and self‑directed learning abilities.

In addition, the club offers several special projects:

· «Knizhnyy psikholog» – analysing books through the lens of psychology.
· «Ledokol» – warm, welcoming events for having fun and making new friends.
· «Tsifrovoy kompas» – using modern tools to boost digital literacy.

text: The Military Training Center at the Financial University is a structural unit where full-time students can undergo military training alongside their civilian education.
Training is voluntary, based on a contract with the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation.
Training programs:
reserve officers — 2.5 years (semesters 3–7);
reserve sergeants — 2 years (semesters 3–6).
Military occupational specialties:
officers — MOS 030400, 030405, 030406, 097000 (Missile Forces and Artillery), 310101, 310201 (Financial Services of the RF Armed Forces);
sergeants — MOS 140 (rocket artillery), 143 (mortars).

First-year bachelor's and second-year specialist's degree full-time students are eligible for selection.
Selection takes place from March to July and includes: submitting an application addressed to the rector, medical examination, professional aptitude testing, and passing physical fitness standards.
Students with Category 4 professional suitability are not admitted; those with Categories 2 and 3 go through two selection waves.

Classes are held one day a week (9 academic hours: 6 with an instructor, 3 of self-study). After the theoretical course — 30-day field training in July (for officers — in the 4th year, for sergeants — in the 3rd year). 

Upon successful completion, the rank of «Lieutenant» or «Sergeant» is awarded with enlistment in the reserves.
How to get a deferment?

For Moscow students —
within the established deadlines, you must come to the Military Training Center with your passport, draft registration certificate, and SNILS; all further information will be sent electronically to the military enlistment office.

For non-resident students — you need to register with the Moscow military enlistment office to obtain a deferment and subsequently for admission to the Military Training Center.
You must provide your passport and draft registration certificate/military ID to the district military enlistment office. After registration, you can go to the Military Training Center and receive a deferment from conscription for the duration of your studies.

Address: Moscow, Kasatkina St., 15.
Phone: +7 (499) 270-22-62.

Compliance with migration rules is the obligation of international students. Violation entails a fine (Article 18.8 of the Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation), deportation, and a ban on entry for up to 5 years.
Registration at the actual address.

text.text: All foreign citizens must be registered strictly at the address of actual residence (Federal Law No. 163-FZ of 27 June 2018):

text: In a private apartment — the owner is obliged to register you at the apartment address.
In the Financial University dormitory — registration is arranged by the university (at the dormitory address).

In a hotel — the administration is obliged to register you on the day of check-in for the entire duration of stay and issue an original with a stamp. After leaving the hotel, you have 3 calendar days to register at the new address.
If you are registered at the dormitory but do not actually live there — this is a violation. The university is obliged to deregister you after 10 days of absence (except for trips and valid reasons).

text.text: Procedure upon entry and during the year:

text: Each time upon entry into the Russian Federation, the previous migration card and registration become invalid. You must submit documents for registration anew.
When crossing the border, check the accuracy of the data, the date of entry, and the purpose — «study».
Report to the Migration and Visa Office within 2 working days from the date of crossing the border.
If you have not left the Russian Federation during the year, report for extension of registration 30 days before the expiry of the current one.

text.text: In case of loss or theft of passport, visa, migration card, or registration:

text: Immediately contact the police at the place of stay.
Obtain a certificate (notification slip) of loss — without it, stay in the Russian Federation is illegal.
Notify the Migration and Visa Office by any means.
Failure to contact the police in a timely manner is a violation of the law.

text: The Russian Speaking Club (RSC) is a space where you can freely practice conversational Russian, explore the culture and traditions of Russia, and make new friends among international students.

The club meets several times a month, always in a lively and informal atmosphere: discussing films, books, current events, playing language games, and simply having conversations on interesting topics.

Everyone is welcome at RSC, regardless of their Russian language level. The most important thing is the desire to speak, listen, and learn something new. The club helps not only to improve language skills but also to gain a deeper understanding of Russian culture from those who live it, as well as to find like-minded people from different countries.
